Interface GameView

All Known Implementing Classes:
JavaFxView, StubGameView, TuiView
public interface GameView
View interface (View role in MVC). Implemented by the TUI, the GUI (JavaFX), and stub implementations used in tests. The view knows nothing about Game, Board, Player, or Card: it receives and displays only snapshot objects (DTO). In the client-server setup, a concrete implementation of this interface lives on each client. The network layer delivers GameEvents serialised from the server; the client's controller unpacks them and calls the appropriate show/request method here. Methods fall into two groups: - showXxx(): display a state update (push from model to view) - requestXxx(): ask the user to make a choice (only relevant for local/single-player play; in the networked case the client sends a PlayerAction message back to the server independently)

Player tribes (acquired characters and buildings) live inside PlayerSnapshot, so any view method that receives a player snapshot also receives that player's up-to-date tribe.

    • showLeaderboard

      default void showLeaderboard(String recipient, int myScore, int myRank, int totalEntries, int numPlayers, List<LeaderboardEntry> leaderboard)
      Displays the persistent leaderboard delivered by the server after a game ends (DB leaderboard feature).

      The same method is invoked on every client: each instance receives its own recipient, score and rank, plus the same global leaderboard restricted to games with the same number of players.

      Parameters:
      recipient - nickname this leaderboard message is addressed to
      myScore - final score the recipient obtained in this game
      myRank - 1-based position of the recipient among all the games with the given size; -1 if unknown
      totalEntries - total number of recorded scores for that size
      numPlayers - number of players the game had
      leaderboard - ranked entries for games with that many players

    • requestOfferTileChoice

      char requestOfferTileChoice(PlayerSnapshot player, BoardSnapshot board)
      Asks the player which free offer tile to place their totem on. The full BoardSnapshot is passed so the view can display the complete state (including tiles occupied by other players' totems); the choice itself must still resolve to a free tile.
      Returns:
      the letter of the chosen tile.
